additional_info.subject: Charging Station 312900727005 – False Emergency Stop Button Alert
additional_info.body:
Dear Siemens Support
We activated charging station
312900727005
yesterday, and since then it has been showing a
"Emergency Stop Button Pressed"
alert, even though the button is not actually pressed.
We have tried restarting the station and verified physically that the button is not engaged, but the alert persists.
We would appreciate your assistance in diagnosing and resolving this issue as soon as possible.
If needed, we can provide photos or connect remotely.
Thank you in advance,
Ziv

Fill in date manually
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Hope you are doing well.
FYI-Regarding the reported issue of a false emergency button pressed alarm, we recommend following the steps below to troubleshoot the issue.
Trace the 24V Source:
Start from the QA26 input and trace the 24V power supply path backwards through the circuit.
Identify the origin of the 24V supply by examining each component and connection from the end point (QA26) to its source.
Component Examination:
Focus on the FA7 and FA8 components to determine their role in supplying 24V to QA26.
Verify the functionality of FA7 and FA8 to ensure they are operating correctly and supplying the required voltage
Voltage Check at XD34:19A:
Measure the voltage at XD34:19A.
If 24V is present at XD34:19A, this indicates that the sensors are closed, which implies that the doors are open.
If 24V is not present at XD34:19A, investigate potential issues with FA7 and FA8, as they may be causing the problem.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
